body: Continual-learning agents are systems of models, harnesses, and memory operating over long multi-session horizons. Evaluating and training them requires interleaving tasks with agent-side events such as session stop and start, crons, and memory consolidation. Yet existing benchmarks and training frameworks schedule only the benchmark’s own events, leaving each benchmark and agent pair to build a custom scheduling loop. We present SCLATE, an execution substrate where benchmarks and unmodified agents each add their events to one open event scheduler through an adapter. A hybrid simulated clock…
summaryZh: Apple研究团队推出了SCLATE（Substrate for Continual-Learning Agent Training and Evaluation），这是一个专门为持续学习代理设计的执行基底。该框架通过统一的事件调度器，解决了现有基准测试在处理多会话、长周期任务时缺乏标准化调度机制的问题。SCLATE允许基准测试与代理通过适配器无缝集成，支持复杂的任务交织与内存整合评估，为评估长期运行的AI代理提供了更科学的实验环境。

glossary.explanationZh: 指能够在长期多会话环境中持续学习和演进的AI代理系统。
指为代理运行和评估提供底层支持的框架或平台。
指跨越多个交互会话的长期评估周期。
指代理在长期运行中对历史信息进行整合与存储的过程。
指协调基准测试任务与代理内部事件触发的调度机制。
